title: cenolophon pulcherrimum
intro: Cenolophon pulcherrimum, commonly known as the yellow-flowered tree or yellow tree, is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, pain, and infections. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effectiveness of Cenolophon pulcherrimum in traditional medicine.
